title: Multipart Content-Type Header Fix & cURL Auth Reliability (Copy & Paste)

Added: Pasting a cURL command now detects auth from -u/--user, --digest, --ntlm (with DOMAIN\user splitting), --aws-sigv4, --netrc/-n, and a recognized Authorization header (Bearer/OAuth/Hawk/Basic), and inserts the matching auth block instead of silently dropping the credentials — extraction only, auth-block construction is handled by voiden-advanced-auth's registered parser

Boolean cURL flags with no value (--digest, --ntlm, --netrc/-n, --get/-G) no longer swallow the next token as their argument — previously a flag positioned right before the URL (e.g. `curl --netrc https://example.com`) could consume the URL itself, leaving the imported request with no URL
Fixed: The check that strips a user-set Content-Type header for multipart/form-data requests (so the real auto-generated boundary is used instead) only matched the exact literal string "multipart/form-data" — no trimming, no case-insensitivity, no tolerance for a stray/stale boundary param. Any deviation (e.g. a leading space from curl-style header parsing, different casing, or a leftover boundary copied from elsewhere) left the wrong header in place alongside the real multipart body, causing a boundary mismatch that breaks server-side parsing of the request

Copy as cURL now reads registered auth cURL header extenders (Digest, NTLM, AWS Signature, OAuth2, etc. from voiden-advanced-auth) via a direct context reference instead of a dynamic import of another plugin's app-internal module path, which had no guaranteed runtime resolution and was silently dropping those auth types from generated commands with no error surfaced anywhere
Copy as cURL now surfaces a warning toast for auth types with no static cURL representation (e.g. Hawk, Atlassian ASAP) instead of silently omitting them from the generated command
Description column header row in Key/Value tables now includes a leading separator cell matching the checkbox column width, so Key/Value/Description labels align correctly with their data columns
Improved: AI skill documentation updated with cookies-table, options-table, and other previously missing table node types and their correct attr schemas

title: Path Params Helper
description: Exposes a createPathParamsTableNode helper so other plugins (e.g. postman-import) can programmatically generate path-table blocks.

Added: createPathParamsTableNode helper exported from voiden-rest-api for building path-table blocks programmatically
path-table added to the REQUEST_NODES list used for paragraph spacing after request blocks
Fixed: Copy as cURL now includes JSON/XML/YAML bodies, multipart form data, and binary file uploads, matching what the request actually sends
Copy as cURL now substitutes path params into the URL instead of leaving the {param} placeholder
Creating a new endpoint via /endpoint no longer steals focus back to the first endpoint in the document

title: Block Overview Panel Integration
description: Registers block outline metadata for all REST node types so the Block Overview Panel displays them correctly at their document positions.

Added: Block outline metadata registered for all REST node types: headers-table, query-table, path-table, cookies-table, options-table, url-table, multipart-table, json_body, xml_body, yml_body, and file upload — with labels, icons, and row counts
Request node now renders as a block card in the Block Overview Panel at its actual document position, with method and URL shown as a preview
Changed: Request container is no longer merged into the section header; it appears inline with other blocks in document order
Method and URL child nodes are excluded from the block outline as standalone entries since their data is surfaced through the request block card preview

title: Description Column, cURL Extenders & Help Commands

Added: Description column support for headers, query params, URL form, multipart, path params, and options tables — a '+ Description' button appears when the table has only Key/Value columns; clicking it adds the column uniformly across all rows
Static Key / Value / Description column labels rendered above each table so column roles are always visible

cURL copy now calls registered cURL extender plugins before generating the command, so auth plugins (OAuth 2, Digest, NTLM, AWS) can inject extra headers, query params, and raw flags (e.g. --digest, --aws-sigv4) into the copied output
cURL copy now expands linked/imported blocks before building the command, so inherited auth nodes and headers from parent .void files are included
Register help entries in the command palette for HTTP headers, body types, query params, path params, cookies, and request options

title: Build & Shim Fixes
description: Build system improvements and yaml shim support for reliable OTA loading.

Fixed: Removed catch-all shim that caused xs is not a function runtime error
Added yaml to host-provided shims so YAML body type loads correctly

title: Multipart & Pipeline Improvements
description: Reliability improvements for file uploads and request pipeline hooks.

Improved: Multipart file upload now supports multiple files per key
Request pipeline hook ordering made deterministic
Fixed: URL-encoded body correctly encodes special characters
Response body syntax highlight no longer flickers on large payloads

title: SDK Pipeline Architecture
description: Full rewrite on the new SDK pipeline architecture.

Added: New SDK-based request and response pipeline handlers
cURL import via paste with full header and body parsing
History API integration with custom cURL builder
Improved: All HTTP methods including multipart file uploads
Environment variable substitution across all block types
